title: Store when a session acquired a claim, so `work core held` reads claim time without scanning the claim's events
outcome: Store when a session acquired a claim, so `work core held` reads claim time without scanning the claim's events
acceptance: A regression test shows the SQLite VM steps of a held read stay the same after many non-acquisition events on the held item

The change follows the pre-release migration rules: import maps the new field from existing rows with counts reported, and every live store is migrated before install; the full quality gates pass and a Codex and a Claude review are clean

The claim projection carries the time (or feed position) at which its holder acquired the claim, set by the claim and handoff-acceptance paths and kept by renewals and the holder's revisions, and `work core held` reads claimed_at from it without scanning work events
